source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 913 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 913 was established by Ordinance No. 29334, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 14, 2014. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 913 is established on property located at the southwest corner of Amesbury Drive and Milton Street. The size of PD 913 is approximately 3.009 acres. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 913A: development plan. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 913A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MF-1(A) Multifamily District apply.

(b) Multifamily uses.

(1) Front yard.

(A) Minimum front yard is 10 feet.

(B) The following may project up to five feet into the required front yard:

(i) cantilevered roof eaves and balconies; and

(ii) stoops and stairs that do not exceed eight feet in width and four feet in height.

(C) The following may be located in the required front yard:

(i) retaining walls with a maximum height of four feet;

(ii) fences with a maximum height of four feet; and

(iii) railings for stairs, stoops, porches, and patios with a maximum height of 42 inches.

(D) Fences located in the required front yard must be at least 50 percent open.

(2) Side yard. Balconies may project up to five feet into the required side yard.

(3) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 240.

(4) Height.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, maximum structure height is 48 feet, measured from grade to the highest point of the structure.

(B) The following structures may project a maximum of 12 feet above the maximum structure height:

(i) elevator penthouse or bulkhead;

(ii) mechanical equipment room;

(iii) cooling tower;

(iv) tank designed to hold liquids;

(v) ornamental cupola or dome;

(vi) skylights;

(vii) clerestory;

(viii) visual screens that surround roof mounted mechanical equipment;

(ix) chimney and vent stacks; and

(x) parapet wall, limited to a height of four feet.

(5) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not. The non-pool courtyard area shown on the development plan is not included in lot coverage calculations.

(6) Lot size. No minimum lot size is required.

(7) Stories. Maximum number of stories is four. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Urban Design Standards For Multifamily
Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Minimum sidewalk width is six feet.

(b) Highly reflective glass may not be used as an exterior building material on any structure.

(c) A minimum six-foot-tall fence must be located along the west Property line in the location shown on the development plan.

(d) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(e) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29334)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-913.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29334)
